description: Patch releases of Jellyfin are deliberately not automerged: v10.11.10 was a patch that added two EF Core schema migrations (AddNormalizedUsername, AddUniqueNormalizedUsernameIndex) plus a data routine, and Jellyfin applies those forward-only against the operator's library database on the next restart. A Molecule run that installs a fresh Jellyfin structurally cannot see that risk, so every version bump here stays a reviewed pull request.

linuxserver.io tags this image `<Jellyfin version>ubu<base>-ls<build>` (e.g. `12.1ubu2604-ls50`). Since Jellyfin 12 it no longer adds a plain `<version>` tag, which is all that strict semver used to find, so Renovate stopped seeing new releases. The rule below reduces every tag to its Jellyfin version before comparing; the arch-prefixed, `version-*` and date-based (2020-2021) tags do not match it and are discarded. `loose` versioning (set in defaults/main.yml) is needed because Jellyfin 12 uses two-part versions (`12.1`).

packageRules.description: Compare linuxserver.io's `<version>ubu<base>-ls<build>` tags by their Jellyfin version, so that `jellyfin_version` stays a plain Jellyfin version
